title_chain.zh_h1: 谦虚与谦逊 modesty and humility (Nicolas Bommarito)

spot.html_text: Again, the bulk of contemporary work assumes that modesty and humility are virtues and sees the main challenge as explaining why. For many it was seen as valuable because of its theological role: Aquinas says that humility is important because it makes one open to God’s grace (see Summa Theologica 2.2 Q.161 and Keys 2003).
